mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the supreme decision making body of the Group of Seventy-Seven Countries."
The ministerial meeting is the supreme decision making body of the Group of Seventy-Seven Countries.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the intermediary between the international system and the state."
The region is the intermediary between the international system and the state.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are an increasingly important element of the global trade environment."
Regional trade arrangements (RTAs) are an increasingly important element of the global trade environment.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to cooperative activities between newly industrialised southern countries and other, lesser-developed, nations of the Southern Hemisphere."
South-South Cooperation refers to cooperative activities between newly industrialised southern countries and other, lesser-developed, nations of the Southern Hemisphere.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a positive step and an important measure towards strengthening global nuclear disarmament and non-proliferation."
The establishment of Nuclear Weapons-Free Zones is a positive step and an important measure towards strengthening global nuclear disarmament and non-proliferation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a multidimensional concept that includes internal and external elements."
Scholars agree that security is a multidimensional concept that includes internal and external elements.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a concern for economic and environmental reasons."
Resource depletion is a concern for economic and environmental reasons.
